---
name: Bug report
about: Report reproducible Muse Remote behavior
title: "bug: "
labels: bug
---

**Environment:** OS, Android version (if relevant), Node version, Muse Code CLI version, PWA/native build version.

**Reproduction:** steps with a fresh test session, expected result, actual result.

**Diagnostics:** sanitized console output and screenshots only. DO NOT POST tokens, login details, QR codes, file contents, session transcripts, hostnames or public tunnel URLs.

**Tests:** what did you try already?
